steps.text: Root cause: --fx-opacity-glass / opacityGlass only applies where a component's customization has glass:true (framework/core/engines/customize.ts case 'glass'). Settings dialogs and most panels never set it, so the transparency token does nothing there.

Fix: every dialog, settings interface, panel, popover and floating surface uses a token-driven glass background by default (surface mixed with opacityGlass + blur). Add per-surface-type tokens (glass on/off and opacity per surface type: dialog, settings, panel, menu, toolbar, banner) in tokens.style, editable in Token Control and per instance in Quick settings. Rule: everything visual is driven by a token; add a check that fails on hard-coded backgrounds/opacity. Follows skins. Tests, Shipped features.
